name: Bureau of Land Management
description: Manages public lands and natural resources, supporting responsible land use, conservation and habitat management.

name: Natural Resources Conservation Service
description: Provides technical and financial assistance to agricultural producers and landowners to conserve natural resources.

name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
description: Supports the conservation of fish, wildlife, plants and their habitats.

name: Nevada Division of Conservation Districts
description: Supports Nevada's conservation districts in implementing locally led natural resource conservation programs.

name: Nevada Department of Wildlife
description: Protects and manages Nevada's wildlife resources and associated habitats.

name: University of Nevada, Reno Extension
description: Provides research-based education and resources related to agriculture, horticulture, natural resources and community development.

name: National Association of Conservation Districts
description: Represents conservation districts nationwide and supports locally led conservation through advocacy, education and funding opportunities.

name: Nevada Association of Conservation Districts
description: Supports collaboration, education and representation among Nevada's conservation districts.

name: Nevada Section of the Society for Range Management
description: Promotes sustainable rangeland management, education and the conservation of rangeland resources.

name: Conservation District of Southern Nevada
description: Promotes natural resource conservation, education and community partnerships in Southern Nevada.
